name: Clara G
description: Clara G trained as an architect and currently works on the mechanisms communities need to own and care for what they hold in common. Komma, the research and relational-technology collective she contributes to, works with communities and institutions to design, pilot and test the legal, economic, cultural and technical systems that make that possible, with an initial focus on land and housing, and drawing on AI and web3 technologies where relevant. She is also part of the Ops team at dOrg, a web3 dev shop that has operated as a DAO since 2019.
